FX-UPSCALE-001.says: The settings as they start: scale 100, no softening, Detail 20: the drawing the same size, its edges a little sharpened (an unsharp mask of 0.4 at sigma 0.5).

FX-UPSCALE-002.says: Scale 100, Detail 0: the drawing as it is.

FX-UPSCALE-003.says: Scale 200, Detail 0: Lanczos-3 alone; the layer grows to 32 by 20 and fills the composition.

FX-UPSCALE-004.says: Scale 200, Detail 20 (as added): FX-UPSCALE-003 sharpened at sigma 1.

FX-UPSCALE-005.says: Scale 200, Detail 100: sharpened twice over, halos at the line and the band.

FX-UPSCALE-006.says: Scale 150, Detail 0: the layer grows 4 each side across and 3 down (24 by 16), the middle unmoved.

FX-UPSCALE-007.says: Scale 200, Reduce Noise 100, Detail 0: softened at sigma 2 before the enlarging.

FX-UPSCALE-008.says: Scale 200, Reduce Noise 50, Detail 50: softened at sigma 1, enlarged, sharpened by 1.

FX-UPSCALE-009.says: Scale 300: the layer 48 by 30, cut by the composition's edges.

FX-UPSCALE-010.says: Scale 100, Reduce Noise 100, Detail 0: softened only.

FX-UPSCALE-011.says: Scale keyed from 100 at frame 0 to 300 at frame 4, linear, Detail 0: as it is, then 200 at frame 2, then 300.

FX-UPSCALE-012.says: Detail keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, scale 200: frame 0 is FX-UPSCALE-003, frame 4 FX-UPSCALE-005.

FX-UPSCALE-013.says: Scale 200, Detail 20, the layer moved 3 pixels right: FX-UPSCALE-004 moved; columns 0 to 2 empty.

FX-UPSCALE-014.says: Scale eased from 200 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots, Detail 0: at frame 2 it would pass below 100 and is held there, so frames 2 and 4 show the drawing as it is.

FX-UPSCALE-015.says: Scale 99, below 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-UPSCALE-016.says: Scale 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-UPSCALE-017.says: Reduce Noise -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-UPSCALE-018.says: Reduce Noise 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-UPSCALE-019.says: Detail -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-UPSCALE-020.says: Detail 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
